title: EXP-007-R2 — Clean Replay: Form Description Persistence Across Previously Verified Unload Sequence
objective: In a fresh worker context, prove that FX_FormPropertyLab06 does not already exist, create exactly one new User-scope classic BuildFromScratch Form using the verified basic-form recipe, record its scoped identity and baseline Form properties, intentionally edit only the Form-level Description to `Form Property Description Lab Replay`, ordinary-save to a clean state, close the target, read but do not modify `Unload IDO Metadata With Forms` and continue only if it is CHECKED/enabled, invoke Form > Definition > Unload All Global Form Objects exactly once, then reopen the exact same Form Name + ScopeType=User + ScopeName version and verify that Description persisted while all recorded comparison properties remained unchanged. Finish with a read-only uniqueness, preference, and repository-scope audit. If every acceptance check passes, classify the EXP-007 Description-persistence procedure as replay_verified at the factory/harness level; do not generalize beyond the tested environment and workflow.

acceptance_checks.description: Before any mutation, evidence proves FX_FormPropertyLab06 is absent by exact and case-insensitive checks in the observable Form inventory, and the pre-creation total/FX_ counts are recorded.

Exactly one new classic BuildFromScratch Form named FX_FormPropertyLab06 is created through the verified basic-form workflow in User scope with Save Template unchecked; post-creation inventory evidence shows exactly one target and the expected one-record increase.

Before Description is edited, evidence records the target's Form Name, ScopeType=User, ScopeName, Caption, Description, Version, Device Type, Form Type, and Is Master; Description is initially empty unless the environment visibly supplies another baseline value, which must be recorded rather than assumed.

Evidence shows that only the Form-level Description is intentionally changed from its recorded baseline to `Form Property Description Lab Replay`; ordinary Designer Save completes and the Designer is demonstrably clean afterward, with recorded comparison properties unchanged.

After the clean Save, FX_FormPropertyLab06 is closed through supported Designer UI, and `Unload IDO Metadata With Forms` is read as CHECKED/enabled without any preference mutation or Save. If it is not enabled, the replay stops as blocked.

Evidence proves Form > Definition > Unload All Global Form Objects is invoked exactly once after the target is closed. No second unload occurs and no error state remains. Any correlated ClearCache network request is recorded only as diagnostic corroboration, not used as the supported action.

After the unload, FX_FormPropertyLab06 is reopened through supported Mongoose UI and evidence proves the loaded customized version has the same Form Name, ScopeType=User, and ScopeName recorded in AC-3.

In the reopened exact scoped version, Description equals `Form Property Description Lab Replay`, and Caption, Version, Device Type, Form Type, Is Master, ScopeType, and ScopeName equal the recorded baseline values.

Final read-only audit proves exactly one FX_FormPropertyLab06 exists, records final total/FX_ inventory counts, confirms `Unload IDO Metadata With Forms` remains CHECKED with no preference mutation, confirms the target Designer state is clean, and proves experiment-attributable repository changes are confined to the EXP-007-R2 record and evidence/EXP-007-R2/ aside from recognized harness/Playwright runtime artifacts.

Only if AC-1 through AC-9 all pass, the experiment record classifies the EXP-007 literal User-scope Form Description persistence procedure across this specific unload sequence as replay_verified by a second independent harness/worker execution. The record must explicitly state that this does not establish behavior for other Form properties, scopes, users, tenants, configurations, cache mechanisms, or Mongoose versions, and no reusable Description recipe is created or modified in this experiment.
